provenance: Seeded from the real a2a-itk JSON-RPC captures in _bmad-output/planning-artifacts/research/a2a-17-4b-dialect-spike-2026-07-18/ (RESP_v03-agent_jsonrpc_noheader.json / RESP_v10-agent_jsonrpc_noheader.json, captured 2026-07-18 with raw curl). The task-object shape (kind:task, id, contextId, status.state lowercase-hyphen, history, artifacts) is the captured real-peer shape on the JSON-RPC binding. The completed arc (submitted -> working -> completed) is the SUBMITTED->WORKING->COMPLETED sequence the reference Python helloworld emits; the a2a-itk agents themselves terminate `failed` without a base64 protobuf instruction (see SPIKE_REPORT.md). No hand-authored happy-path JSON: every field name and casing is taken from the real capture.
no_secrets_note: Contains only synthetic uuids and public task text. No api keys, bearer tokens, or private key material.

parts.text: The corpus contains 141 parseable agent cards.
